svg.title: The Strata of One Archived Item
svg.desc: An exploded isometric projection of the six artefacts one archived item leaves behind: the source physical object, the preservation master, the reading copy, the transcript, the segment index, and the search result. A continuous evidence path runs back up the stack, allowing complete provenance verification.

g.text: EXPLODED ISOMETRIC PROJECTION · 6 DISCRETE RETENTION LAYERS · FULL PROVENANCE TRACE
The physical artifact (book, tape, video) logged with origin,
provenance history, and accession condition metadata.
Raw 600 DPI capture holding paper grain, skew, and foxing.
Captured once, never digitally modified or 'improved'.
FORMAT: 16-BIT UNCOMPRESSED TIFF · NO NOISE FILTER
Derived copy deskewed to platen, cropped to text block,
and contrast-lifted strictly for reading comfort.
Text transcription with recorded method (Manual Checked,
Assisted, or Machine) and uncorrected historical spelling.
Fine-grained token index binding each passage to exact
page/paragraph numbers or millisecond media timestamps.
The instant findable snippet presented to the reader, linked
with one-click verification directly to the raw preservation scan.
